title: File a Jira Ticket
description: Log your first bug report the way real engineering teams do it.

steps.instruction: Open Jira in your browser (atlassian.net or your company's Jira URL)
hints: Your team's Jira URL usually looks like {company}.atlassian.net
If you're not logged in, sign in with your work account

steps.instruction: Click the 'Create' button at the top to start a new issue
hints: It's usually a prominent blue button near the top nav
Shortcut: press C anywhere in Jira

overlay.text: Look for the 'Create' button in the top bar

steps.instruction: Set Issue Type to 'Bug', add a clear summary, and a short description of what went wrong
hints: Summary should read like a one-line headline — what broke?
In the description, include: what you expected, what happened, how to reproduce

overlay.text: Issue Type → Bug. Then write a clear one-line Summary.

steps.instruction: Click 'Create' (or press Enter) to submit the ticket
hints: You should see a confirmation toast with the ticket ID like PROJ-123
